title: SPORTING CLUB 2000 - Schemi di ricezione a 3 nella pallavolo - Under 16
note: Manually transcribed from the coach-supplied one-page PDF. Coordinates are approximate marker centers, expressed as percentages of our half court. Its third panel is headed 'Palleggiatore in zona 1 - P5'; the drawn numbered spots establish that it is P5.
firstSetNote: Reception positions are transcribed from the six PDF diagrams. For the first set, the setter moves to the zone 2-3 setting area even when starting in the back row; this temporary movement uses the existing full-rally setting anchor and is illustrative except for the PDF's explicit P1 instruction to leave after the serve. Other back-row players stay in their PDF reception sectors through the first set; the written middle-to-5 and outside-to-6 assignments describe later defense and do not require a first-set swap. Front-row hitters may move toward their playing areas after the first touch; exact centers and route arrows are illustrative. P1 retains the opposite/outside exception and OH1 is a front-row player despite receiving behind the attack line. P2 has no zone-2 attacker.
coachingRules: The opposite never joins the three-player serve-receive line.
At P1, the opposite attacks from zone 4 and Outside 1 from zone 2; they do not swap.
Back-row middles defend zone 5, back-row outsides zone 6, and a back-row setter or opposite zone 1.
At P2, the coach's scheme has no zone-2 attacker.
